verdict.rationale: Superset documents scheduled automations that can be managed through the CLI, SDK and MCP server, and their output is a live workspace you can review. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning automation definitions, reviewing changes to those definitions, or rolling an automation back to a prior version. Reviewing a run's output, or keeping SDK-managed definitions in Git yourself, is an adjacent feature or user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
